from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialResult(BaseModel):
    """Net profit result extracted from one company's financial filing for a specific period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company the financial report belongs to, as named")
    net_profit: float | None = Field(description="Net profit or loss amount as reported; negative indicates a loss")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period this figure covers, e.g. 'three months ended March 31, 2024'")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    attribution: str | None = Field(description="Optional attribution line if multiple values exist, e.g. 'Net Loss attributable to Company'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_results: list[CompanyFinancialResult]
